| svg-f1     | DN80 discharge line | DN100 or larger (SOP-220 §4.3) | Non-compliant (DN80) | Change to DN100 or larger | Drawing specifies DN80 discharge line |
| svg-f1     | CLASS 150 valve rating on discharge line | At least Class 300 (SOP-220 §4.2) | Non-compliant (CLASS 150) | Change to Class 300 or higher | Drawing specifies CLASS 150 valve rating |

### Recommendations

- **Recommendation for P-204 PUMP SKID - DESIGN REVIEW DRAWING — Change the discharge line diameter to DN100 or larger (SOP-220 §4.3).**
- **Recommendation for P-204 PUMP SKID - DESIGN REVIEW DRAWING — Change the valve rating on the discharge line to at least Class 300 (SOP-220 §4.2).**
